history.text: pebblewick should have every command its README lists. Do add, list and done first, with tests, and keep main returning 2 for a command it doesn't know.

Done. todo.py has open_items, which sorts the open items by due day and keeps the order they were added on a tie, and cmd_add, cmd_list and cmd_done, registered in COMMANDS; main returns 2 and says so for an unknown command. test_todo.py covers adding and listing, done, and an unknown command, and python3 -m unittest passes.
Great. I need to go; what's still missing?

Two README commands are missing. snooze <n> <days> moves the n-th item of list's order that many days later, printing nothing. sweepdone removes the done items from the list itself and prints how many it removed. Each needs a cmd_ function and an entry in COMMANDS; nothing else changes.
